title: Connected Components
description: Build an adjacency list, then DFS from every unvisited node — each fresh DFS launch is one new component. O(V + E).

notes: Push BOTH directions when building adj — the graph is undirected.
Increment count exactly when you START a new DFS from an unvisited node.
Union-Find (DSU) is an alternative: O((V + E) * α(V)). DFS is simpler when you already have the adjacency list.
